**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, VA, Richlands Police arrested 28-year-old Hunter Brian Gill of Richlands on charges including armed robbery after an incident at Big Lots on October 26. In nearby Mercer County, WV, 43-year-old Bobby York of Bramwell was arrested following a domestic incident involving his elderly father. Halloween events and community activities are underway across the core area, with no active NWS alerts or major road closures reported.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/tazewell-county-crime/richlands-police-department-asks-public-for-help-identifying-suspect-in-robbery-investigation/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core**  
- **Richlands, Tazewell County, VA**: Hunter Brian Gill, 28, of Richlands, was arrested and charged with Armed Robbery, Use of a Firearm in the Commission of a Felony, and Brandishing a Firearm. The incident occurred around 3:50 p.m. on Monday, October 26, 2026, at Big Lots in the Richlands area. Gill allegedly showed a gun and demanded money before fleeing; he was identified and arrested later that day/evening following investigation by Richlands Police with assistance from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Tazewell County Narcotics and Violent Crime Task Force, and the Commonwealth’s Attorney’s Office. [OSINT - NEWS](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/tazewell-county-crime/richlands-police-department-asks-public-for-help-identifying-suspect-in-robbery-investigation/)[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/tazewell-county-crime/richlands-police-department-asks-public-for-help-identifying-suspect-in-robbery-investigation/)

- **Bramwell, Mercer County, WV**: Bobby York, 43, was arrested after allegedly punching his elderly father, Johnny York, in the face and pushing him to the floor during an argument on Ramey Street around 7:30 p.m. on October 23, 2026. The incident involved a domestic violence protective order that was served during the response. York has multiple prior domestic battery and assault convictions. West Virginia State Police responded. [OSINT - NEWS](https://www.lootpress.com/man-accused-of-punching-elderly-father-after-being-awakened-in-mercer-county/)[[2]](https://www.lootpress.com/man-accused-of-punching-elderly-father-after-being-awakened-in-mercer-county/)
